Title: Apple Watch flagged a low heart rate? Here's what bradycardia actually means

Description:
If your smartwatch just sent you a low heart rate alert, or you've been feeling unusually tired and lightheaded, a resting heart rate under 60 bpm is called bradycardia - and it's not always something to worry about.

Sleep apnea, certain medications, and vagal overstimulation are three everyday causes worth checking first. Here's why each one matters, and what actually helps stabilize your pulse.
